cards.label: Studio
cards.description: Each instrument's own sound: the sampled instrument this Mac has for it, else beats' synth voice — how tracks sounded before palettes.

cards.label: Synth
cards.description: Beats' own synth voices on every part and its synth kits: no samples at all, the sound of the browser.

cards.label: Synthwave
cards.description: Analog polysynths: PWM and sync leads, warm pads, rubbery FM bass, an 808 or CR-78 under a long bright hall.

cards.label: 8-bit
cards.description: Square and pulse waves like a game console's sound chip, a tight dry room and a little machine kit.

cards.description: A band in a room: piano and guitars, electric or upright bass, organ chords and a real drum kit.
